headline: Give AI one focused job
intro: AI Task lets Home Assistant automations, scripts, and the interface send a single job to an AI integration and receive a result. Depending on the entity, that job can generate text or structured data, create an image, or evaluate a question.
highlights: AI task entities come from AI integrations such as OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Ollama; available actions vary by entity
When an action does not specify an entity, Home Assistant uses the preferred AI task entity for that kind of task
The Suggest button uses the preferred entity for data generation, including suggestions for an automation name, description, category, and labels

flow.title: From task choice to result
stages: Choose preferred entities by task type
Send a single job from an automation, script, or Suggest
